I build AI systems where evaluation and verification matter.

ComicMainEngine: End-to-end generative comic pipeline. Automating comic creation from script to panels using multi-provider LLM and image generation. VLM rubric gates ensure each panel meets quality standards. Successfully completed all initial board tasks.

Procedural City: 3D city generation with LLM scene direction. Generating coherent urban environments under budget constraints using schema validation at each phase. Currently progressing through the pipeline with spend tracking.

BeamDojo: Reproducing Isaac Lab locomotion research. Training humanoid robots to walk on beams using PPO on Lambda GPU. Currently running initial smoke tests with Weights and Biases tracking.
